'''Roast Smapp''' was an [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The roast was cost 8.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was served with hot [[barium liquid]] as part of the diner's [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran plate special]] available for lunch and dinner on [[Zhellday/Legends|Zhelldays]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roast Smapp was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
